description: This Java class 'MigrateDataSet' is a test utility designed to migrate and convert DBUnit XML files from an old database schema to a new schema. It performs recursive directory scanning for XML files, sets up a temporary MySQL database, applies schema and data updates, and exports the migrated XML files. It leverages external libraries such as dbunit for dataset handling and JDBC for database connectivity.

classes.name: MigrateDataSet
classes.description: A utility class for migrating DBUnit XML datasets from an old schema to a new schema by loading, updating, and exporting datasets

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that prompts user to select directories and initiates migration process on selected directories

methods.name: doMigration
methods.description: Recursively processes files and directories to convert XML files by applying old schema, old updates, and exporting the result

methods.name: execMysqlCmd
methods.description: Executes specified MySQL commands or SQL scripts using system shell, manages temporary database setup and data import/export
